name: ut-pod-contract
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json
from pathlib import Path
pod=json.loads(Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/ut/main-ut-pod.json").read_text())
container=next(c for c in pod["spec"]["containers"] if c["name"]=="ut")
status=next(c for c in pod["status"]["containerStatuses"] if c["name"]=="ut")
expected_image="docker.io/library/vllm-ascend:kv-pool-layerwise-main-54503ece-a2-14beaf16-20260731T064607Z-r1"
expected_config="sha256:c30f98cf41591582bdb78dde264074a834b68137c5c9254e886cb1347f88bf57"
assert pod["metadata"]["namespace"]=="liangjiahao" and pod["metadata"]["name"]=="vllm-ascend-ut"
assert pod["spec"]["nodeName"]=="n1" and pod["status"]["phase"]=="Running"
assert container["image"]==expected_image and status["imageID"]==expected_config
assert status["ready"] and status["restartCount"]==0
resources=container.get("resources",{})
assert "huawei.com/Ascend910" not in resources.get("requests",{}) and "huawei.com/Ascend910" not in resources.get("limits",{})
assert all("hostPath" not in volume for volume in pod["spec"].get("volumes",[]))
assert any(volume["name"]=="workspace" and "emptyDir" in volume for volume in pod["spec"].get("volumes",[]))
mounts=[mount["mountPath"] for mount in container.get("volumeMounts",[])]
for forbidden in ("/root/.cache","/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64","/usr/local/bin/npu-smi","/usr/local/dcmi"):
    assert forbidden not in mounts
env={item["name"]:item.get("value") for item in container.get("env",[]) if "value" in item}
assert "VLLM_VERSION" not in env
assert env["TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD"]=="0"
assert env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]=="1" and env["PYTEST_ADDOPTS"]=="-p no:cacheprovider"
assert pod["spec"]["automountServiceAccountToken"] is False and pod["spec"]["enableServiceLinks"] is False
print(json.dumps({"validated":True,"namespace":"liangjiahao","name":"vllm-ascend-ut","node":"n1","image":expected_image,"image_id":expected_config,"main_verified_lane":True,"vllm_version_override":None,"npu_resources":False,"host_path":False,"driver_mount":False,"model_mount":False,"workspace_empty_dir":True,"restarts":0},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'

name: source-history
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,subprocess
run=lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(args,text=True).strip()
repo="repos/vllm-ascend"
head=run("git","-C",repo,"rev-parse","HEAD")
merge_base=run("git","-C",repo,"merge-base","collaborator/kv_offload_0723","HEAD")
count=int(run("git","-C",repo,"rev-list","--count","collaborator/kv_offload_0723..HEAD"))
merges=run("git","-C",repo,"rev-list","--merges","collaborator/kv_offload_0723..HEAD").splitlines()
dirty=run("git","-C",repo,"status","--porcelain=v1")
assert head=="14beaf161cca6f1e044e20529ca96c6554dbbe50" and merge_base=="a46a1dabbc260e8695002969f29528eb555eb583" and count==11 and not merges and not dirty
print(json.dumps({"head":head,"merge_base":merge_base,"commit_count":count,"merge_commits":merges,"dirty":False},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'
